institution: Norwegian Geotechnical Institute (NGI) / Centre for Research-based Innovation (Klima 2050, Norway)

C1.name: Slope Geometry Modification
C1.description: Re-profiling slope geometry to decrease driving shear stresses or increase resisting forces.

C2.name: Surface Water Drainage
C2.description: Interception, conveyance, and rapid discharge of storm surface runoff to minimize rainfall infiltration.

C3.name: Subsurface Drainage
C3.description: Depression of internal groundwater phreatic surface and dissipation of destabilizing pore water pressures.

C4.name: Retaining Systems
C4.description: Structural earth-retaining gravity, cantilever, or composite walls providing mechanical toe retention.

C5.name: Internal Ground Reinforcement
C5.description: Deep in-situ structural inclusions transferring tensile, shear, and compressive loads into stable ground.

C6.name: Surface Protection & Slope Armoring
C6.description: Surface covers, draperies, and surficial facings to prevent progressive weathering and localized detachment.

C7.name: Runout & Debris Impact Barriers
C7.description: Passive barriers, catch basins, and deflection bunds positioned to dissipate kinetic energy and arrest runout debris.

C8.name: Nature-Based Solutions: Soil Bioengineering
C8.description: Living vegetative ground architecture combining live woody/herbaceous root reinforcement with hydrological transpiration.

C9.name: Nature-Based Solutions: Vegetated Structural Systems
C9.description: Composite structural frameworks incorporating live willow/native cuttings within cribwalls, gabions, and geogrids.

C10.name: Erosion Control Mattings & Geotextiles
C10.description: Biodegradable natural coir/jute meshes stabilizing topsoil seedbeds during vegetative establishment.

C11.name: Monitoring, Warning & Institutional Preparedness
C11.description: Instrumented sensor telemetries, early-warning thresholds, and statutory zoning restrictions.

measures.name: Excavation & Benching of Slope Crest
measures.description: Unloading the driving mass by removing overburden or cutting intermediate benches (3-5m width).

measures.name: Slope Flattening / Reprofiling to Angle of Repose
measures.description: Trimming over-steepened hill cut face to a flatter stable inclination (e.g. 1:1.5 to 1:2).

measures.name: Toe Counterweighting Berm (Rockfill / Earth Berm)
measures.description: Constructing a compacted ballast berm at the slope toe to provide resisting moment against circular slip.

measures.name: Crest Interceptor Catchwater Drain
measures.description: Trapezoidal lined channel excavated 5-10m uphill of detachment crown to divert sheet runoff away from slope face.

measures.name: Stepped Concrete Cascade / Chute Drain
measures.description: Energy-dissipating stepped RC flume conveying concentrated water down steep slope faces into valley culverts.

measures.name: Herringbone Surface Feeder Drains
measures.description: Branching network of lined shallow chevron channels preventing water concentration and ponding on slide body.

measures.name: Sub-Horizontal Directional Relief Drains (GEO Standard)
measures.description: Array of perforated PVC pipes (50-75mm dia, 15-30m length) drilled at 5-10 deg upward rake into slope to depress water table.

measures.name: Deep Granular Trench Drains (French Drains)
measures.description: Deep continuous trench (2-4m depth) backfilled with graded aggregate wrapped in non-woven geotextile with slotted base pipe.

measures.name: Vertical Drainage Relief Wells / Siphon Drains
measures.description: Deep vertical drilled boreholes equipped with passive siphons to bypass impermeable perched aquifer layers.

measures.name: Plum Concrete Gravity Breast Wall (IS:14458 / IRC:SP:48)
measures.description: Massive M15 gravity retaining wall incorporating 40% clean sound boulder plums (<=150mm) to resist active earth pressure.

measures.name: Double-Twisted Wire Mesh Gabion Wall (IS:16014)
measures.description: Flexible, free-draining galvanized wire mesh baskets filled with sound river rock boulders to support toe surcharge.

measures.name: Mechanically Stabilized Earth (MSE) Wall with Geogrids
measures.description: Engineered granular fill reinforced with high-strength polymeric geogrids and facing units for tall embankments.

measures.name: Passive Grouted Soil Nailing Array (CEDD Geoguide 7 Standard)
measures.description: Closely spaced grid (1.5-2.0m) of high-yield steel bars (25-32mm) fully grouted into pre-drilled boreholes with RC head pads.

measures.name: Prestressed High-Tensile Rock Anchors
measures.description: Post-tensioned multi-strand steel cable tendons anchored deep into bedrock to tie back unstable structural rock wedges.

measures.name: Micropile Root Reticulated Network
measures.description: Small-diameter (100-200mm) steel-cased drilled piles acting in composite 3D shear groups to arrest slip surface shear displacement.

measures.name: Active High-Tensile Steel Wire Mesh Drapery (TECCO / Steelgrid)
measures.description: Diamond wire mesh pinned securely against slope face using soil nails and perimeter boundary ropes to arrest rock detachment.

measures.name: Fiber-Reinforced Shotcrete Facing with Weep Holes
measures.description: Pneumatically applied concrete skin (75-100mm) reinforced with steel/polypropylene fibers to seal moisture-sensitive shales.

measures.name: Flexible Ring-Net Rockfall Barrier (500 kJ to 3000 kJ per GEO 138)
measures.description: High-energy flexible barrier with steel posts, ring nets, and friction brake rings to arrest high-velocity falling boulders.

measures.name: Flexible Debris-Flow Ring Barrier (GEO Report 138 VX/UX Class)
measures.description: Multi-level ring nets anchored across mountain torrents with bottom clearance to retain boulder fronts while passing slurry.

measures.name: Reinforced Concrete Debris Deflection Wall & Impact Basin
measures.description: Massive cantilever RC wall aligned obliquely (30-45 deg) to deflect debris runout away from road corridors into natural ravines.

measures.name: Deep-Rooting Vetiver Grass Contour Hedges (Chrysopogon zizanioides)
measures.description: Dense linear vegetative hedges with 2-3m deep massive fibrous root systems (tensile strength ~75 MPa) providing mechanical soil binding and hydraulic shear enhancement.

measures.name: Live Fascines & Brush Layering with Native Himalayan Shrubs (Vitex negundo)
measures.description: Bundles of live dormant woody branch cuttings buried in shallow trenches along slope contours to trap colluvium and root rapidly.

measures.name: Live Vegetated Crib Wall / Timber Cribbing
measures.description: Hollow box-like interlocking timber or precast concrete beam framework backfilled with soil/rock and planted with live root cuttings.

measures.name: Coir Geotextile Netting (700-900 GSM) with Hydroseeding
measures.description: Biodegradable open-mesh coconut coir blanket pinned to trimmed slope face to shield bare soil against raindrop splash erosion during germination.
